claim.purpose: Complete the unfinished #5409 production supervision, observed readiness, assembled soak, and credential-overlap acceptance boundary

findings.summary: Expired non-revoked credentials cannot recover after the renewal window is missed.
Readiness exempts Audit and Evidence channels that channel policy classifies as required.
CSM weather readiness overclaims CPU, memory, and GPU observations from disk pressure only.
The synthetic supervisor test does not execute the production daemon cycle or typed channel fabric.
Credential audit events record a fixed overlap instead of the clipped actual duration.
Repair documentation and the sprint register overstate the first revision's proof.
Near-expiry rotation can retain a previous credential that does not outlive the replacement creation timestamp.
Concurrent rotation can overwrite a terminal revocation and restore an active credential.

residual_risks: Strict all-target Clippy is blocked by two pre-existing cav.rs test warnings outside #5494.
